grh_176d67fc909325d06507.title: The Ghost and Mrs Muir
paragraphs: Widowed Lucy Muir moves with her daughter into Gull Cottage despite warnings that the seaside house is haunted by its late owner, the irascible Captain Daniel Gregg. Lucy refuses to be frightened away, and when money troubles threaten her home, Daniel dictates his colorful sea memoir, Blood and Swash, while she puts it on paper. Their unusual partnership deepens into love, but Daniel urges Lucy to live among the living. She falls for writer Miles Fairley, only to discover that he is already married. Daniel, believing he is standing in the way of her earthly life, has already made her think their years together were only a dream. Lucy grows old at Gull Cottage with only fragments of those memories, and when she finally dies Daniel returns, restores her youthful spirit, and takes her with him into the afterlife.
GRH catalogs [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]]'s "The Ghost and Mrs Muir" for August 16, 1951, as episode 116.
The surviving audio runs about 60 minutes.
